sections.what: Brings in icons, the back navigation, the button, the upload component and the card layout.

sections.name: ReportUploadPage (part 1)
sections.title: Page header, uploader and privacy card
sections.what: Shows a back button, the page title 'Add Medical Record', the upload area, and a privacy card explaining that reports are encrypted and processed in a compliant way.
sections.why: The privacy card is placed beside the upload so users see reassurance before sending medical data.
sections.watch_out: The privacy text states security facts that this file does not check. Keep it accurate as the system changes.

sections.name: ReportUploadPage (part 2)
sections.title: Filing tips card
sections.what: Shows a card with three tips: capture all four corners, avoid glare, and prefer PDFs for better AI insights.
sections.why: Better photos or PDFs make the scan more accurate.
sections.watch_out: The tips are fixed text. If the scanner changes, the advice may need updating.

summary: The Add Medical Record page that holds the upload area for a report, with a side panel of privacy statements and photo or PDF tips.
purpose: Lets a user add a new medical report and gives guidance so the scan works well.
why: Reason for the side panel is partly visible: the privacy and tips cards are there to build trust and improve scan quality.
how: The page draws a header with a back button, a main area that holds the ReportUploader component, and a side column with privacy and tips cards. The upload work is done inside ReportUploader, which is not in this file.
inputs: The user's click on back and whatever the uploader component accepts.
outputs: The upload screen, and a back navigation when the back button is pressed.
risks: The privacy card says reports are encrypted end to end and processed in a HIPAA compliant way. This file cannot prove those claims, so they must be checked against the real system before they are shown to users.
debug: If the upload does not start, the problem is most likely inside ReportUploader, not this page. Check the console and that component. If the claims are questioned, confirm the actual encryption and compliance setup.
